description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and s_pop frequency, with the x-axis labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)” ranging from 1 to 19 in integer increments and the y-axis labeled “Accuracy” ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot displays two distinct lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers and a green solid line with square markers. The blue line begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.72 at s_pop frequency 1, rises to a peak of approximately 0.99 at s_pop frequency 9, and then remains nearly constant at approximately 0.99 through s_pop frequency 19. The green line starts at an accuracy of 0.36 at s_pop frequency 1, increases to a peak of approximately 0.70 at s_pop frequency 7, then declines to approximately 0.45 at s_pop frequency 13, and rises again to approximately 0.99 at s_pop frequency 17 before stabilizing at 0.99 through s_pop frequency 19. Both lines exhibit error bars, indicating variability in the measurements at each data point.
